lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, becoming significantly more compressed and less defined at the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped bifurcation identified on the 4th line from the anterior at the dorsal-lateral transition; merging of segments 11 and 12 occurs at the upper dorsal region of the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is truncated dorsally; the final three posterior lines are fragmented into abbreviated segments that fail to reach the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 6 high-contrast white spots localized on the upper posterior haunch and distal pelvic area.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal band on the anterior surface of the lower forelimb; distinct white patch present at the ventral base of the neck.
